text:
lucy: quick sync: onboarding maelstrom-v1 hybrid-quant (mixed int6/float16) + PQ(8) prototype. ran multi-lang recall + MRR sweep. seeing good MRR but recall@1 drop for es/fr vs en. attaching summary.

eval-bot: run summary: model=maelstrom-v1-hybrid | quant=mixed-int6-fp16 | pq=8bytes | index=ivf_flat_pq | normalize=true | langs=[en,es,fr,zh] | recall@1: en=0.83 es=0.68 fr=0.70 zh=0.62 | baseline_float: en=0.86 es=0.80 fr=0.81 zh=0.65 | mrr_delta=-0.01 overall | per-lang silhouette_delta: en=-0.01 es=-0.12 fr=-0.09 zh=-0.03 | eval-id r-3741592653-a

rahul: interesting. hybrid quant with PQ can distort small-norm components that are language-specific. did you retrain OPQ (optimized PQ) per-language or global?

lucy: used global OPQ matrix trained on combined corpora. tried per-lang OPQ briefly but didn't persist results to main run.

tamsin: can we try per-lang OPQ + separate IVF centroids? partitioning the index by language often helps avoid cross-lang centroid collapse. not ideal long-term but useful diagnostic.

nikhil: also check tokenization differences for zh — we use char-level tokens sometimes; that changes embedding stats. did you run the per-lang norm histograms?

eval-bot: per-lang stats attached: avg_norms: en=1.02 es=0.86 fr=0.88 zh=0.57 | PQ_recon_error_mean en=0.06 es=0.14 fr=0.12 zh=0.18 | sample_query_len_tokens en=12 es=9 fr=10 zh=4

rahul: PQ recon error is a smoking gun for es/fr. PQ on low-dim residuals amplifies reconstruction noise for languages with shorter sequences. try: - increase PQ bytes to 16 - or reduce PQ and rely on hybrid fp16 for residuals.

lucy: good call. i'll spin two configs: (A) pq=16 + same OPQ global, (B) pq=8 + per-lang OPQ + ivf-per-lang. also add (C) pq=0 (no PQ) using ivf + hybrid quant to measure PQ-only impact.

rahul: add a rerank ablation: top-20 ANN candidates -> re-rank with float-interop dot on uncompressed embeddings (store float128? joking) — realistically rehydrate float16 residuals for top-k. that often recovers recall@1 while keeping index small.

tamsin: yes do re-rank. please include MRR@5 and recall@1 per-lang for the rerank ablation. also produce cluster purity by language (how many nearest neighbors are same-lang).

lucy: starting runs now on canary cluster, job ids: r-3741592653-A/B/C. expect ~30m per run. logs to: https://redwood.artifacts/maestro/3741592653/ (will post individual links).

ops-bot: scheduled on canary-ops-5 at 02:10 UTC. watcher enabled. job tags: ml-onboard, maelstrom, pq-sweep.

nikhil: tiny extra: check normalization timing. Are we L2-normalizing before OPQ/PQ or after? doing it before vs after changes PQ residual distribution.

lucy: currently: embed -> L2 norm -> opq -> pq. i'll add after-normalize variant: embed -> opq -> pq -> renorm.

rahul: cool. when results land, let's compute: per-query delta heatmap and flag queries with >0.4 drop in similarity score. we can add those to regression set.

tamsin: +1. also run a small human spot check for es/fr top-5 results for 50 random queries to ensure qualitative quality not just metrics.

lucy: noted. I'll post back with run summaries and the per-lang artifact links. thanks everyone. :rocket:
